verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is operated through a programmatic SDK (sandbox.exec(), writeFile(), sessions, ports). The evidence shows no first-party natural-language command interface. Being 'ideal for building AI agents' and publishing an llms.txt are developer building blocks and adjacent features, so they earn no credit toward operating the product in natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
